newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul shrs close at 3-year low, blue chips fall.
newsitem.headline: Seoul shrs close at 3-year low, blue chips fall.

text.p: The Seoul bourse slid to a new three-year closing low on Monday, pressured by heavy selling from domestic institutions, brokers said.
The composite stock index fell 13.42 points to end at 673.92, the lowest close since September 4, 1993, when the index fell to 665.66.

"The market sentiment, which started the day weak, was further shaken when a leading investment trust company heavily sold Samsung Electronics and LG Information shares. This sent most blue chips down," said a Shinyoung Securities broker.
